|game_text=Deploy on [[Jabba's Palace: Rancor Pit{{!}}Rancor Pit]]. May ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. During your battle phase, if you have no presence here, may relocate a captive from [[Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber{{!}}Audience Chamber]] to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|hatnote=Other versions of this card: [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones]] (Original), [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3), [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4), [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 5)]] (PC-E5), [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 6)]] (PC-E6).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones]]. * '''Original''' ([[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet, first copy (official text as of 4 September 2009)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>, and in the revised copy (PDF dated 20 April 2010)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 5, slip 32. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a site with “Waters” in game text. During your battle phase, if on Rancor Pit, may relocate a captive from Audience Chamber to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. May use 1 Force to ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata)]]): announced in the Players Committee news post “Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes” (23 July 2010, effective 26 July 2010)<ref name="src-S4">Players Committee news post "Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes", 23 July 2010. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100820023348/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=255:pre-worlds-2010-errata-changes&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Rancor Pit. During your battle phase, if you have no presence here, may relocate a captive from Audience Chamber to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. May ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' deploys on Rancor Pit (not on a site with “Waters” in game text); the captive may be relocated “if you have no presence here” (not “if on Rancor Pit”); the ▼ of a creature no longer costs 1 Force.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 27 July 2010 (an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook)<ref name="forum-p568455">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 27 July 2010: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=0#p568455 p568455] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “Deploy on Rancor Pit. May ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. During your battle phase, if you have no presence here, may relocate a captive from Audience Chamber to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the creature sentence moved from the end to the second sentence. The post writes the ▼ as “May deploy” and the immunity as “[Immune to Alter]”; those are notation, not changes.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 3)]]): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 9 May 2012, to be published in Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook (“Obviously it obsoletes any previous errata to this card”)<ref name="forum-p719737">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 9 May 2012: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=40#p719737 p719737] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “Deploy on Rancor Pit or Execution Arena. During your battle phase, if on Rancor Pit and you have no presence here, may relocate a captive from Audience Chamber to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. May ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' deploys on Rancor Pit “or Execution Arena”; the captive may be relocated only “if on Rancor Pit and you have no presence here”; the creature sentence is at the end again. [[Execution Arena (Pit)]] lets you ▼ Dark Waters there, which only this text allows.

May ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. During your battle phase, if you have no presence here, may relocate a captive from Audience Chamber to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the PC-E3 text is gone: word for word the PC-E2 text again (the list writes the ▼ as “May deploy”, which is notation). A repeat of an earlier text after a different one was published is a version of its own (wiki versions ruling, 11 November 2026).
